## Acceptance criteria
AC1 Post to the Slack channel configured per Jira project. (description)
AC2 A Slack outage must not fail or slow the run. (description)
AC3 The channel is configurable without a code change. (description)
Trigger: "When a report refresh run finishes with failures" (description); summary says "test run".

## Review constraints

## Code map
No run / refresh / failure concept in the repo. `grep -rniE 'refresh|run|slack|jira|project|webhook|process.env|fail' src test` → no hits.
src/reports.js — getReport/listReports; src/exports.js — exportCsv; src/server.js — handleGetReport;
src/store.js — in-memory Map (no jiraProject field); src/usage.js — emitUsage (pattern for side effects).
No config/env loading, no outbound HTTP anywhere.

## Design
Inventory:
- Runtime & deploy: helm chart `charts/reports-svc` in `devops/helm-charts` (repo CLAUDE.md) — NOT FOUND via GitLab MCP (list_repository_tree / get_repository_file: no data; search "reports-svc": 0 results).
- Config & secrets: none in repo; chart missing → config source unknown.
- External systems: Slack not called anywhere; no credential known to be provisioned.
- Standards: repo — emitUsage on user-facing actions; branch prefixes feature/, bugfix/. Global — every action emits usage event; zod for external inputs (repo has no deps — conflict).
| # | Decision | Chosen | Class | Source / why | Reversible? |
| 1 | Placement — where the run lives | ? | ask | no run exists in repo | — |
| 2 | Contract — how a run carries its Jira project | ? | ask | no jiraProject field anywhere | — |
| 3 | Config & secrets — channel map + Slack credential source | rec: `SLACK_WEBHOOKS` JSON env from secret store via chart | ask | AC1, AC3; chart not found | yes |
| 4 | Execution & failure | fire-and-forget, global fetch, 2s AbortSignal timeout, no retry, log error | default | AC2; Node 20 stdlib | yes |
| 5 | Standards — usage event for alert | rec: none (system action) | ask | repo vs global CLAUDE.md wording | yes |
Prerequisites: Slack app/webhooks created; chart + secret entries added (owner unknown) — blocks AC1, AC3.
Infra changes: other repo (helm-charts) — listed, not done.
ADR suggested: no (unless a new external integration pattern is being standardised)

## Change plan
Pending answers to Open questions 1–3.

## Test commands
unit: `npm test` (package.json scripts.test); lint: `npm run lint` (package.json scripts.lint); no typecheck (plain CommonJS).

## Not doing
Building a refresh/test runner from scratch — not in the ticket's scope as written.

## Open questions
1. Which run, and where does its code live? (rec: another repo — name it)
2. How does a run know its Jira project? (rec: the runner passes the key)
3. Channel map + Slack credential source, and who owns charts/reports-svc? (rec: SLACK_WEBHOOKS JSON env from secret store)
